chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfaly, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'A time will come upon my community when their inner selves will be foul and their outward appearances beautiful, greedy for the world, and not intending what is with Allah, their Lord. Their religion will become show-off; fear will not mix with them. Allah will encompass them with punishment from it, so they will supplicate to Him with the supplication of the Drowning One, but He will not answer them.'

key_terms.دُعَاءَ الْغَرِيقِ: the supplication of the drowning one

ai.seo_question: What is the state of the community's faith and supplication when they become hypocritical and greedy for the world?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Shia emphasis on 'batin' (inner reality) versus 'zahir' (outer appearance), warning that superficial piety driven by dunya (worldly gain) leads to a state where supplications become ineffective, akin to a drowning person's cry. It underscores the concept of 'riya'' (show-off) as a spiritual disease that severs the connection between the believer and Allah, rendering ritual acts void of acceptance.

en.hubeali: H 14924 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nowfaly, from Al-Sakuny, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws has said that the Rasool Allahsaww said:

‘There will come a time upon my<sup>saww</sup> community when they will be ugly in their inner selves and beautiful in their appearances. They will be greedy for what is in the world and will not be intending what is in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, their Lord<sup>azwj</sup>. Their Religion would have become a (matter of) show-off. Fear will not have entered into them. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Prevail over them with Punishment. So they would be supplicating by the supplication of the Drowning One (Du’a Al-Ghareek), so He<sup>azwj</sup> will not Answer to them’.
en.sarwar: 477. From him, from his father, from Al-Nowfaly, from Al-Sakuny, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said that the Amir-ul- Momineen (a.s.) said:

‘When the jurists and the scholars used to write to (deal with) each other, they did so in three ways, and there was no fourth. The one who thought of his Hereafter, Allah (azwj) Sufficed for his concerns of the world. And the one who corrected himself in secret, Allah (azwj) Corrected him publicly. And the one who corrected with regards to what was in between him and Allah (azwj), Allah (azwj) Blessed and High Corrected with regards to what was in between him and the people’.
